title: Hierarchical Graph Convolutional Network Approach for Detecting Low-Quality Documents
abstract: arXiv:2610.21350v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Consistency within a document is a crucial feature indicative of its quality. Recently, within the vast amount of information produced across various media, there exists a significant number of low-quality documents that either lack internal consistency or contain content utterly unrelated to their headlines. Such low-quality documents induce fatigue in readers and undermine the credibility of the media source that provided them. Consequently, research to automatically detect these low-quality documents based on natural language processing is imperative. In this study, we introduce a hierarchical graph convolutional network (HGCN) that can detect internal inconsistencies within a document and incongruences between the title and body. Moreover, we constructed the Inconsistency Dataset, leveraging published news data and its meta-data, to train our model to detect document inconsistencies. translated_title: 用于检测低质量文档的层次图卷积网络方法
translated_abstract: 文档内部的一致性是衡量其质量的重要特征。近年来，在各种媒体产生的大量信息中，存在大量缺乏内部一致性或内容与标题完全不相关的低质量文档。此类低质量文档会使读者产生疲劳感，并损害提供这些文档的媒体来源的可信度。因此，基于自然语言处理自动检测这些低质量文档的研究势在必行。在本研究中，我们提出了一种层次图卷积网络（HGCN），它可以检测文档内部的非一致性以及标题与正文之间的不一致性。此外，我们利用已发布的新闻数据及其元数据构建了非一致性数据集（Inconsistency Dataset），用于训练我们的模型来检测文档的非一致性。实验结果表明，HGCN...
tldr: 该论文提出了一种层次图卷积网络（HGCN），能够检测文档内部的非一致性以及标题与正文之间的不一致性，并构建了相应的非一致性数据集用于模型训练，从而实现低质量文档的自动检测。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a hierarchical graph convolutional network (HGCN) that detects internal inconsistencies within documents and incongruences between titles and bodies, together with a newly constructed Inconsistency Dataset for training, enabling automatic detection of low-quality documents.
